author: Numberz_
body:
Hi there, 

another player was using an illegal modification on Avicus this morning.  As you can see in the evidence he is using a pretty awesome hacked client which allowed him to break multiple rules at once. I believe he was using forcefield and derp but I'm not 100% sure. 

His user name was Digestive18

Evidence: https://youtu.be/WfXb0sY7mD8

Thanks <3
